title: Special Topics in French Studies; Louange, critique, calomnie, censure: Reputation and Media in France, ca. 1200-1700
description:
Prerequisite: FREN351 or FREN352, and FREN387

An overview of the strategies employed to construct -- or destroy -- the reputation of public figures over time in France. What is considered relevant to someone s reputation? How do different genres approach the construction or destruction of a reputation? What kinds of controls were exercised over public discourse, and what can and cannot -- or should and should not -- be said about other people? Taught in French.
